results.reason: Issue 2 says a change of more than 50% of voting stock is a deemed assignment requiring Vantrell's consent, with termination on 30 days' notice. It also notes that Schedule 4.4 says 'None', so the §7.2(c) condition and §3.2(g) deliverable require nothing.

Issues 2 and 19 note that under Supply §16.1 Vantrell may assign freely, 'including to a competitor', while Corbel cannot assign without consent. The fix seeks protection against assignment to a Halvorsen competitor.

Issue 3 calculates the 120-day deadline as September 2, 2026, says it has passed with no evidence of notice, and says the contract expires Dec. 31 without extension. The SPA's 'as of' September 21 date is noted, so the deadline plainly preceded the signing date.

Issue 1 explains that Side Letter §2 limits Fundamental Reps to §§4.1 and 4.2. Because §11.11 gives the Side Letter precedence, §§4.3 and 4.12 lose uncapped treatment and become subject to the $8.45M cap.
